name: ZclockID Enterprise v1.1.3
summary: Fix sidebar navigation tab active highlighting and border synchronization across all tabs
notes:
### What's Changed in v1.1.3:
* **Navigation Tab Highlighting Fix:** Fixed issue where moving away from Dashboard left the new active tab unhighlighted. Standardized `border` on all sidebar navigation buttons and implemented symmetrical active/inactive class swapping (`text-indigo-300`, `bg-indigo-600/20`, `border-indigo-500/40`, `font-semibold`, `shadow-sm`).
* **Consistent Visual States:** Cleanly resets previously selected buttons to transparent borders and neutral slate colors upon switching tabs without layout shifts.
